intent: Write the test for R2dbcEventLogRepository (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/eventlog/infrastructure/R2dbcEventLogRepository.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. R2DBC adapter of EventLogRepository over table telemetry_record (columns exactly as declared in migration V1, keyed by device_id, metric, t_device, revision). Strictly append-only: only INSERT and SELECT statements, revision computed from the stored maximum for the key; corrections and backfills insert a new revision and never touch earlier rows. TEST DUTIES: REAL-SUBSTRATE: execute the actual V1 migration DDL on the embedded H2 substitute via Flyway, call append and assert the durable row (telemetry_record row fields): first append yields revision 1 kind RECORD, a second append for the same key yields revision 2 kind REVISION with two rows present and the first unchanged, a different key starts at revision 1, findLatest returns the highest revision, VALIDATION_FAILED status is persisted.

methods.signature: Mono<EventRecord> findLatest(String deviceId, String metric, Instant tDevice)
